components.institution_label: Faculty Modified Work Assignment for Maternity / Paternity
components.description: A full-time faculty member with at least one year of service may request a modified work assignment of up to 6 weeks (up to 15 under special circumstances) after a birth or adoption, once available sick leave is used; the modification of teaching, service and research is agreed with the chair and decided by the Provost.
components.faculty_group_note: a full-time (100% appointed) faculty member, who has been employed by the university for at least one (1) year
components.eligible_parent_wording: Maternity / Paternity; following childbirth and/or adoption; If both parents work for the University
components.service_requirement: full-time (100% appointed); employed by the university for at least one (1) year
components.entitlement_note: The member 'may request'; the modification is 'as agreed upon between the faculty member and the department chair/head', and the Provost's written decision 'shall be final' and may change the proposal. No minimum relief is stated, so the form and amount are agreed with no guaranteed minimum (R12), and the grant itself is also discretionary (V2); R12 gives negotiated precedence.
components.duration_note: up to six weeks' maximum; up to 15 weeks under special circumstances (not defined). Taken during the academic year and completed within twelve months of the child's arrival.
components.dual_employee_rule: If both parents work for the University and are requesting a modified work assignment, each parent's request must specify how long the other parent is requesting to be on a modified work assignment.
components.time_window: During the academic year; must be completed within the first twelve months of the time the child has joined the faculty member's family by birth or adoption
components.notice: approximately four (4) months' notice from the anticipated due date of birth or adoption
components.relief_note: Modification of teaching and/or service and/or research/creative responsibilities as agreed with the chair; amount not stated; may include working from home; the department covers or substitutes teaching duties. Advising and clinical duties are not named (R4b).

sequence.note: The member uses all available sick leave before the modified work responsibilities begin (FH 3.14, FPP 419.0).

notes: Governing documents for faculty leave are saved: Faculty Handbook 3.14 and Fayetteville Policy 419.0 (modified work assignment), Board Policy 405.1 with Academic Policy 1405.11 (tenure clock), Board Policy 420.1 with Faculty Handbook 3.13 (leave for academic personnel). missing = false. 2018_05 (employment periods) holds no leave provision.

Reference date 2018-03-13. Board Policy 405.1 is the 2001 text; its version note says its next revision (2018-03-29) post-dates the reference date. Undated HR handbook pages are 2017 captures (reference academic year 2017-18).

No paid parental leave of any kind: pregnancy is treated as any temporary illness, paid only from the employee's own sick leave (and, for twelve-month staff, annual leave), with an unpaid leave option that does not require exhausting balances. The only parent-specific benefit beyond FMLA is the modified work assignment, discretionary and with its form agreed with the chair (coded negotiated), with no pay level stated (full pay inferred under R3 and flagged).

Chain, birth parent: own sick leave (within FMLA 12 workweeks, from the start) -> modified work assignment up to 6 weeks (15 special) once sick leave is used; maternity leave without pay (no length) concurrent with FMLA; catastrophic donated leave, discretionary, only after all balances are exhausted.

Chain, non-birth parent: own sick leave for a seriously ill spouse (within FMLA) -> modified work assignment up to 6 (15) weeks; paternity leave without pay (HR 7.7 only, no length) concurrent with FMLA; FMLA 12 workweeks for bonding (combined 12 when both spouses are university employees).
Annual leave accrues only to twelve-month nonclassified employees (coded by group name, general purpose). Nine-month faculty earn none.

Calendar: the documents name Fall and Spring Semesters and a Summer Session (BP 420.1 sick leave; BP 405.1 'academic year (fall and spring semesters ...)'); no term length stated, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Cited but not saved: Board Policy 420.2; Universitywide Administrative Memorandum 435.2 and 435.3; Fayetteville Policies and Procedures 419.1 (nonclassified staff MWA); Staff Handbook FMLA text at hr.uark.edu/currentemployees/153.aspx; the long-term disability plan; Arkansas Code sections and Acts behind sick leave and catastrophic leave; Act 835 of 2003; HR Handbook 7.10 Military Leave; Board Policy 450.1 (outside employment, irrelevant); the Application for Leave of Absence without Pay and extended sick leave forms.

Not components: military leave, court and jury leave, vacation leave for graduate study (cannot serve a birth); the sick-leave return-to-work accommodation of medical restrictions and FMLA temporary transfer for planned treatment (general disability provisions, not pregnancy-specific); leave without pay as a reasonable accommodation for disabilities (general).
U8: the catastrophic leave bank requires two years of service, which the member described has; FMLA eligibility assumed.
